The fairy-dust particle trail in love-magic.js is adapted from:
Tim Holman / cursor-effects, src/fairyDustCursor.js
https://github.com/tholman/cursor-effects
https://github.com/tholman/cursor-effects/blob/master/src/fairyDustCursor.js

Upstream package.json declares version 1.0.18 and license MIT. Its readme also
declares the project MIT. Retrieved October 15, 2026. No remote script is loaded.

Local changes: canvas vector shapes and rose/gold palette; click hearts;
scroll-edge petals and section reveals; time-based updates and particle caps;
idle/background suspension; touch, text-input, game/map and motion guards.
